claude.sample_unit: men's health topics (UCF resources compared with ChatGPT responses)

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT and UCF patient education materials versus recommended sixth-to-eighth grade level
links.effect: Both UCF and ChatGPT failed official readability standards; ChatGPT performed significantly worse across all 6 topics (all P < .001).
links.quote: Both UCF and ChatGPT failed official readability standards, although ChatGPT performed significantly worse across all 6 topics (all P < .001).

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of ChatGPT patient education output (readability and understandability)
links.effect: ChatGPT responses were longer and more complex, failed readability standards, and had worse understandability than UCF; the sixth-grade prompt improved readability, meeting the recommended level for 2 topics.
links.quote: Qualitatively, UCF and ChatGPT had comparable accuracy, although ChatGPT had better comprehensiveness and worse understandability.

unlisted_practices: Prompting a chatbot to explain at a sixth-grade level to simplify patient education materials

links.effect: Adjusted ChatGPT readability typically surpassed UCF and met the recommended level for 2 topics.
links.quote: Conversely, adjusted ChatGPT readability typically surpassed UCF, even meeting the recommended level for 2 topics.
